description: medfate simulates Mediterranean forest functioning and dynamics through vegetation cohorts. The R package implements published forest processes and provides compiled code, documentation and links to related modelling packages. The resource is documented by medfate development team. The model represents Mediterranean vegetation cohorts; site resolution and simulation periods depend on the configured inputs. The documentation is publicly accessible. Licence: GPL (>= 2) OR LGPL (>= 3), as stated by CRAN. Access is described as free. Dataset contents, software execution and reported outcomes were not independently tested. It can supply vegetation and water-balance behaviour for green-infrastructure scenarios; that application is a curator inference, not a verified infrastructure deployment.
